input.free_text_description: This system is a authentication platform that serves User, Admin roles. It manages core business objects including user, role. The platform provides capabilities for user, jwt user details, user. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include user management functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a User, I want to create and manage user records, so that I can track and organize user data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage role records, so that I can track and organize role data effectively.
As a User, I want to interact with index functionality, so that I can accomplish my index-related tasks.
As a User, I want to interact with base functionality, so that I can accomplish my base-related tasks.
